notes.title: Unity Betrayed Us
notes.content:
I normally stay away from the hot stuff in the news and keep focusing on my work without bothering, but what Unity announced this week affects my work itself in too many ways for me to stay idle. 

It not only insults the work of every single indie developer out there but it also adds a lot of uncertainty for the developers that have chosen to focus their career path on Unity like I did. 

I mainly write this article to put oil on the fire they started in hope that they get burned badly enough to cancel their new ridiculous policies. And if they don't, well we won't be able to safely put a price tag on Chaos Crown at all, so consider this my attempt to shake things up with what little voice I have.

I invite you to directly read their policy announcement here, but if you're ready to take my word for it here are the main key points that will affect us and the rest of the indie games ever made with Unity, take note that there are flaws and grey areas that they'll clarify with time :


 A $0.02 to $0.20 per first install fee when a game sells for 200k or more (that threshold can change anytime). Includes already released games, so expect some games you like to be completely removed from the market before January if their owners are unable to pay them. Those fees are fixed and can change at any given time, which will drive up global game price inflation higher than ever before. Moreover, there is no telling as to how they'll manage to detect if a game has been pirated, which means that companies may get overcharged. We also have no access to the algorithm they'll use to calculate first installs so it might end up being fraudulent in nature. 

This is a change in how we do business with Unity and no one was consulted, agreed to or had a warning about this sudden change. Should this policy last, we won't publish any game made with Unity to the Steam Store.

 x4 the prices of subscriptions and removed the lower tier so that you're forced to go full price.

 Dependency to WIFI to run any Unity versions or Unity games.

 Anti competition policies with their micro transaction tools that will over time give them a monopoly over the market.


Fun fact, the Unity CEO is the one that introduced loot boxes during his time at EA. He's also famous for having suggested in a video call that players should pay real money to reload in-game ammo. He also sold 2k of his Unity company shares just before announcing this, which is what we call insider trading : a crime that will at the very least get him in the court room.

As of now Unity has received death threats and a major backlash from the development and gaming community. I can only hope things get worse for them. 

You might have heard this from other games already. 

I don't have a clear answer as to what can be done. I guess that if you feel as angry as I am about what they're about to do, our best bet is to give them the greatest backlash they've ever seen. Make your voice be heard. If this policy passes expect only more abuses from companies.

EDIT :
Unity has updated their policy announcements 10 days later :

A cap of 2.5% of the profits to calculate the install fee and the option to pay the lower price between both of the numbers.

Unity is now comparable to Unreal in its pricing policies. We can now rest assured that the install fee wont screw us too much. We can also avoid to pay them by keeping our current version of Unity (since it was not legal to make us accept those terms on previous versions in the first place!!)

 x4 the prices of subscriptions and removed the lower tier so that you're forced to go full price.

 Dependency to WIFI to run any Unity versions or Unity games.

We'll be able to publish our game after all, but we won't be sticking with Unity for our next projects, unless they do something really impactful to regain our trust.

notes.title: Our 2023 Objectives and Maintenance Update
notes.content:
Due to the loss of our 3D artists, we have encountered difficulties in creating new scenes for the procedural path system while simultaneously working on new features, menu creation or rework, bug fixes, and other system updates such as enemy pools, reward pools, crafting system, and playable characters.

To address this issue and reduce the workload associated with 3D environment creation, we have taken inspiration from games like Risk of Rain 2 and decided to introduce medium-sized maps as a solution. Each map theme, such as Stravux, Fawynn, Flamoria, and Rotgrave, will now feature a small village home base. From these bases, players can visit the Guild of Adventurers to create their own quests by selecting contracts and then teleport to medium-sized hostile environments where they can complete the chosen objectives. This new gameplay loop will offer various rewards, including experience points, notoriety, specific items or loot boxes, gold, and data crystals.

Furthermore, we will be implementing a new level system. Up until now, only players had levels, but with this update, enemies will also have their own levels. Given that hostile maps will feature all available enemies, this addition will help players gauge whether they should engage or flee from specific encounters.

Players will have the ability to teleport between home bases in search of specific rewards for their builds until they have completed every map.

To officially complete a map, players simply need to defeat the big boss of the hostile environment. As a reward, players will receive a piece of a legendary Chaos Crown, which can be assembled in a special menu. Once the Crown is fully restored, players can challenge the Chaos Lords and make a wish for their champion. An intriguing twist will be revealed in due time.

Regarding the leveling system, we have decided that skill tree upgrades should be permanent for each champion. Upon leveling up, players will be offered a choice of three randomly selected skill upgrades from a pool. Additionally, some of the secondary skills on the champion's bar may be chosen from this pool, as players have expressed a desire to have more control over their non-basic skills, such as Fire Rain, Barrage, Arrow Spray, and others.

We value your feedback on these upcoming changes! Please let us know your thoughts.

Patch Notes:

This update focuses on bringing the demo version up to date with our most recent changes in the base game.

Numerous improvements have been made to enhance stability and overall quality of life.

Additions:


 The AI now utilizes a new logic for selecting and using skills. While this change may not be noticeable for simple minions, it has greatly improved the behavior of complex enemies like bosses.

 We have introduced a new Ogre Shaman, which will serve as the final boss for Stravux in the new map system we are developing, it is not in the demo, but will be once the new system is fully implemented.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/6f6ab7d1d46acbbd0276d14bb3322bcf6f6fe720.png

 You can now open the map menu at any time by pressing "M". Please note that this feature may not be very useful in the current demo.

 We have implemented a new music system that independently detects combat in each room. It will play new tracks that we have purchased from Vindsvept on YouTube. These tracks should provide a more immersive medieval fantasy experience.

 The Treasure Hunter achievement now has an increased chance of being completed. It will also count every type of chest in the room, including treasure chests, reward chests, and mimics. To obtain this achievement, we recommend combining the luck passive of the archer with the Treasure Map item or forging an item with Treasure Map as the second component. This way, you can spawn treasures at will by spamming a proc condition.


Please let us know if you encounter any bugs. With these major structural changes, there is a possibility that something may have been unintentionally broken during our playtesting that we did not notice.

Remember, you can always join our Discord Server at https://discord.gg/CxU6JnRBpw!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Dash Skills cooldown adjusted to lower values, enabling spamming again.

 Improved the way we detect icons in skill descriptions, fixing the issue that was most noticeable in the French translation.

 The tutorial text that appears when taking Data Crystals for the first time has been made more noticeable for better clarity.

notes.title: Companions Update
notes.content:
Hello champions! Today we're excited to announce the latest update to Chaos Crown, which includes a number of exciting new features, quality of life improvements, and bug fixes. Read on for all the details!

Additions:


 Sprint: You can now sprint in the game using the shift key, increasing your movement speed. To balance this increase in mobility, dashes skills are now less spammy.

 Jump scaling: The jump scales with the sprint velocity for a more immersive experience.

 Field of view: A new field of view system has been added to enhance the sprint experience.

 Harvest system: You can harvest items from 3D models.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/881af7f6a409c731a30d37e2082b3cde6685fbd3.jpg

 Data Crystals: A new resource, Data Crystals, has been added to the game and can be found in the hard rooms and introduction rooms. You can trade them in the new companion system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/27ccb7f78d218b2af0edd5e10078285dcb2b3fc7.jpg

 Companion system: You can trade Data Crystals to create your own guild members with three races and three job classes, each with a focus on utility rather than combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/0643706a9743e1285c176eabe020dd1fa5de4f40.jpg

 Dynamic tutorial: A dynamic tutorial system has been added to help guide you through the new features in the game.

 FMOD sound: More sound references have been added to FMOD in the background, improving the sound quality of the game. We noticed that some debug sounds have been introduced in this update. You may not notice them, but if you do we're sorry (we'll try to update soon).


Quality of life improvements:


 Player physics: Player physics scripts have been updated to prevent players from falling through the ground as often.

 Snowball damage: The snowball active now deals more damage and uses physics to simulate a more accurate explosion on hit.

 Terrain tool: A tool to dig into the terrain and create bridge-like structures is now supported. This will increase the potential of our maps.

 Dash cooldown: The dash cooldown gets reset when you are hit by immobilizing effects, allowing you to break free from any situation.



Bug fixes:


 Voice system: Fixed issues with the voice system that caused enemies to emit more than one sound at a time.


We hope you enjoy these updates and we look forward to bringing you more exciting features in the future! Thanks for playing Chaos Crown!

notes.title: More Loot, Chilled Status & Fixes
notes.content:
This update brings new rewards and bug fixes.


Additions :


 5 new items compatible with the crafting system for the Stravux map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/dd20681891760241c0b0c376fab9c2e7ea659d1f.png

 Added the Mysterious Cube and the Snowball rewards to the crafting system.

 A new status effect called chilled has been added to the game. To break from it you simply have to dash in any direction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/b8f5a66ce2d46feba1e5a097cdc970317a838c72.gif

 The snowball boss will wait a few seconds before making another snowball. Your projectiles will no longer be deflected by snowballs so you can hurt him at any point in time.

 In order to let players get the Greedy Champion achievement on any map, the Cup of Greed has been categorized as a generic chaos reward.



Fixes :


 Fixed the Gotta go Fast! achievement. To get it you must max out the movement speed passives of the Archer and either gain enough speed stacks or to get the Boots item reward.

 Fixed the Archer's Quick Shot upgrades (IV, V, VI).

 Fixed the Challenge Boss Room's lightning.

 Fixed an issue that caused the snowball boss to flee constantly.



Note : We found a subtle bug with the animation canceling system when heavily spamming attacks (usually your primary attack will be stuck and the animations will behave strangely). We're currently trying to find a way to reproduce it easily. Let us know if you find it.

The next update will either add enemy variety or more rewards. Let us know what should be focused next!

Have a spooky week!
-The team.

notes.title: Hotfix : Elemental Bar, Chaos Lord Curses
notes.content:
A few bugfixes from the feedback we received last patch!


Bugfixes :


 Prevented animation canceling across skill bars to fix an issue with the Lava Elemental's charged skills.

 Fixed an issue that bugged the chaos lord menu.


Let us know if we missed something.

Have a nice weekend!
-The team.

notes.title: Combat Fluidity & Legend for Statistics Icons
notes.content:
This update improves the combat fluidity and brings improvements to the stat icons. Tiny bugfixes included!


Quality of Life Improvements :


 The combat system's fluidity was greatly improved by allowing animation canceling. Whenever you use an skill, you can use another to cancel its animation and immediately cast it!

You can thank ccFireball for this great suggestion that will allow players to do any combat action at any time. Let us know if you find any issue due to this change!

 @NelsieOo on Instagram reworked most of the icons. We find them way easier to read, but that's not all!

 A new legend system will now show the keywords behind each icon displayed on screen. This currently does not support gold or the cooldown symbol of crafted items (for now).


Bugfixes :


 Fixed an issue that made the rays of light used for dialogues not show after ending a fight with a Mimic or a final boss.

 The placement of area effects did not use the same logic as the skill preview system, now it should be more coherent, although the placement logic itself has quite a large error margin that will need to be reworked soon.


Team update :

Two new members may join us soon to work on both UI, item rewards and enemy additions. Nothing is definite yet but we're optimistic!

notes.title: More Settings & Some Tweaks!
notes.content:
Hello! Here's a small patch that focuses on quality of life improvements.


Additions : 


 Sliders inside the Options Menu show a value. This should help us know the exact value of the settings when someone sends us a screenshot.

 Added a setting to control camera sensitivity.

 Added a setting to control the tooltip font size. It was requested by a player some time ago :)

 Increased the base movement speed, lets see if that was enough to smooth the gameplay.

 Added a merchant zone near the spawn point of the final boss room in Stravux.

 The stat icons have been reverted to their older raw texts while we keep working on a new version.


The next update should focus on improving the fluidity of combat.

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Welcome to Stravux
notes.content:
Your feedback is gold to us, that's why today we are rotating the demo map to Stravux, The Forzen Sea. 

You brought nice improvements to the Forgotten Woods and we know you'll do the same for this area.

In its first weeks, Stravux will be missing enemies and items. We'll periodically add new content as we collect more feedback and finish the planned features. Keep in mind nothing here is final.

Additions :


 Stravux the Frozen Sea :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/8040f85862280316c9422c5ecf21bb8408792329.png

This location is themed around frost and magic. The Chaos Lord lurking in its white cloak is a hungry Wendigo. A special stun mechanic will soon be added to this area, more details to come on that part. 

We have not found the time to add unique items or sound to this map (yet). The rewards will pretty much only contain generic items until the next update.

You'll notice that the scenes load much faster than on the previous map. This confirms that the destructible trees where causing the loading issues.


Fixes :


 Fixed a bug that made the wandering enemies try to get to the world origin instead of circling around the player, this was only happening when getting the second or the third wave of enemies.

 Fixed an issue that spawned the enemies at invalid locations.


Team update :
Loïc Bouchard is leaving our team to pursue other projects. He greatly contributed to Chaos Crown's maps and he'll be missed. We are currently looking for a new 3D Level Designer to continue the room production. As much as I would like to spend time on new room visuals I have to focus item rewards and monsters for now. The level production will be slowed until we find a new team member.

Discord :
We decided to add a private Discord Channel for the members of the community who would like to chat directly with the devs without notifying everyone in the Discord Server. Communication should be more fluent with invested players. To join this channel just ask for it (preferably inside Discord) or let us know what is your Discord username so we can add you correctly.

This is an exciting phase of the development. Your ideas will have a great impact since this map is still very young and no items have been yet decided. Let us know what you would adjust and what you want to see added!

Take care,
The team.

notes.title: Combat Improvements, World Map and More!
notes.content:
Welcome back! Today's update delivers quality of life improvements to combat in general. We'll also share with you a bit of the progress of the map : Stravux, the Frozen Sea.

If you have any feedback let us know on our Discord Server!

Additions :

 Enemies no longer aim at the player or move after starting an attack animation. Let us know if some of them do not follow this rule.

 Whenever an enemy uses a spell, a shape similar to the ones you've seen while holding skills appears. Staying in the red areas may result in receiving damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/09dfc6d12433ab23b6060868af7c6924f916dfbf.jpg

 The friendly skills have blue shapes while the dangerous ones are colored red.

 Combat rooms will spawn the next wave after 18 sec of combat. Let us know if the delay needs to be adjusted.

 @NelsieOo on Instagram finished the first iteration of the world map! Here it is:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/ca5dd15a3ac191d9d382699188b18a5fbbccf8bc.jpg
Gorgeous, isn't it? This is our current vision of the Chaos Crown universe. An entrance to the Chaos Lord realm will eventually be added.

 Added a new VFX for shields.

 Added black borders to the statistic icons.


Bug Fixes :

 Fixed an issue that made the game not remember the rooms visited, allowing you to visite twice in a row the same room. Let us know if you get this bug again after starting a fresh game.

 Fixed the big imps. The melee imps have a different texture instead of being beefy.

 Applied a translation fix from @Zythum's feedback (thank's again!).


Stravux, the Frozen Sea :

The land of the Ice Titans is under construction. Loïc is currently having fun with our frozen assets. Here are screenshots of his recent creations :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/1d5598466c19aac89114e00241272656ebcc255d.png

We are getting more confident over time. We want to aim a little higher, especially with Challenge Rooms. Why not make a dungeon out of them?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/e60586ebc986c8f0a762b612a4a374faba02ea55.png

We made a system for environment enemies. This should allow us to place enemies that are not part of the waves and add secret location that should spice the exploration of challenge rooms.

The final boss of Stravux will be an Ice Dragon. As a big Skyrim fan, I really want it to switch from flying to grounded, to remind us of this amazing game. Its a coding challenge that I'm currently enjoying.

A few enemies where made for Stravux : an Ice Elemental, Baby Drakes, Hungry Snow Rabbits, and a Zombie Bear full of Zombie Rats. We sometimes post short videos on our YouTube Channel if you want spoilers.

We are getting featured in a Roguelite Steam Event! Any feedback before Monday would help us a lot!

Have a nice weekend!
—The Team

notes.title: Level Up Menu & Extra Enemy Waves!
notes.content:
We aimed at two of the most requested additions, here they are!

Additions :


 Level Up Menu when the TAB key is pressed, designed by @NesieOo on Instagram! Exiting this menu will automatically enter the skills tree if you have unspent passive points. Opening it without any active points opens the skills tree directly. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/0d8316909f0f35c9dfac9e413c7947da2c72581a.jpg

The foundations are set, we can expect a rework eventually.

 More enemy waves the further you adventure! You'll will fight up to 3 waves of enemies per combat room. You'll start to see the second wave at 10% progression in the path and the third one at 45% path progression. 

 Added an alternate version of the Imp enemy that throws 3 fireballs at a slightly higher speed than the slimes.

 Common foes give almost 3x less gold, but give the same amount of XP to compensate their numbers.

 Loïc Bouchard added an Ice combat room and an Ice treasure room to the main game! He also optimized even more the existing forest rooms!

 The final boss room has been adjusted a little for you to not look for the boss or the exit portal.

 The forest intro room contains a hidden reward chest. 

 Dummies health bars are hidden until you or your minons give the first hit. I wont talk about them again, their mechanic is secret after all ;)

 The previous version of the demo had errors liked to the save system. Every time this happens you'll wont be able to choose a character. When such errors occur the only quick fix is to purge your game saves. This may happen again so added a detector of save errors when clicking choose or when selecting a map. It'll show a panel that informs you that an exception was throwed and will suggest a "purge" button. The error will also be printed to the screen so it can be screenshot and sent to us in the Discord Server.

 Items are filtered depending of the map to vary the rewards from a location to another. Some items will also be more generic and will have a chance to appear anywhere in the game. We hope that this feature will answer one of the top negative comments of other fellow roguelites : diluted reward pools. It'll also add weight to the choice of the starting map if you have a specific build in mind.

Fixes :


 Fixed a weird terrain reference in one of the Forest Combat Rooms.

 Fixed an error linked to the save system (the one that was preventing new players to play multiple games).

 Adjusted the auto selection for controller support.

 Fixed an issue that made the blacksmith really tiny.

 A few tests proved that you can still encounter the same enemy type twice in a row. Another fix has been made. Let us know if you still encounter this issue in a new game.


Its quite a change for the gameplay loop, tell us what you think of it!

We are slowly building the lore too! The Ice Chaos Lord is named Tatonga! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/913770809031dd5fd125ff02a0720b10c4a05687.jpg
It'll be a famished Wendigo themed around health mechanics such as lifesteal, max health and potentially health regen. He likes to taste the meat of mortals and is a little unstable. He might hunt you down or try to take a bite when you refuse a deal.

Stay safe and healthy!
—The Team.

notes.title: Archer Rework & More!
notes.content:
Additions :

 The archer's ultimate (Dramatic Shots) has been changed for a quick attack with no cooldown. Without using its synergies, its a skill even weaker than your basic attack. It can be combined with Quick Shot and Barrage to proc strong effects. Go check it out and tell us what you think!

 Execute skills deal deathtouch damage instead of directly killing their targets. This will make stronger foes immune from all instant kill effects and therefore balance one-shot effects.

 Barrage slows the enemies inside. Also reworked its three last upgrades.

 The final boss rooms starts with a merchants like in the treasure rooms, but without the reward chest. The main purpose of this addition is to let you use all of your rewards against your final foe.

 Loic Bouchard made more adjustments to the forest rooms.

 Special feature : Mannequins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/505656bd75f64e906a00f957359392c18111cd73.jpg

This was initially intended to be used by our developers only when working on playable characters, but since there is a few dummies placed in the game, we decided to make it part of a secret way to gain skill points. That's right, if you take the time to destroy them, you'll gain all the xp required to level up! It is rather easy to destroy them with minions ;)

 The game should no longer open the same room visual twice in a row or make you fight the same enemy waves twice in a row.

 Most of the texts are starting to use the icons of the combat system to simplify the descriptions. The numbers are also highlighted with an azure color.

 @NelsieOo on Instagram made progress on the map menu and reworked the design of both the crafting menu and the shop menu  :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/bd8f2faa1558349d7d6b7af41933b42bede91008.jpg
I'm really excited to see the final version of the map menu!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/6855a13826c658bd52da31a2232ba85a1888d65b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/30c2d9f42dbf15415c69d8fab293fbc053bee90d.jpg

 The crafting menu has a switch button to quickly see to two potential results.

 The combat menu shows the keys to switch between active items.

 We started to use FMOD, a sound engine that works hand-to-hand with Unity. This took way more time to put into place than intended, but it'll show benefits as the students that work with us get to experience with their creations and adjust accordingly to any feedback. A part of the UI sounds and some of the Archer's attacks are currently attached to FMOD.

 The hover shader of the crates and the chests fades depending of your distance. This should be a quality of life improvement while the menus and an exciting addition for treasure hunters.


Fixes :

 Loic Bouchard reworked some parts of the navmesh. The AI are starting to climb a little, but it still needs more adjusting.

 Adjusted the English translation even more based on the feedback left by @Rylatar (thanks again for your time, it's really appreciated by the team and the community for sure)!


We answered most of the feedback received at this point. We are going to enter a development phase focused on massive additions for the main game (won't necessary impact the demo). This may take more time than usual, so we'll try to cut this between small updates.

Hope you're doing well,
Have a nice weekend!
—The team.

notes.title: Performance, Fixes & More!
notes.content:
The Games from Quebec event just ended and we've had a blast! Your feedback has already impacted the course of development. This update shows a fraction of the good you did to Chaos Crown!

Additions :


 Since our team and our community keeps growing, we decided to take a moment to design a credits menu. @NelsieOo on Instagram made it so we don't forget our biggest contributors and team members. Its button will be available in the Main Menu.

If you're mentioned and you would prefer to stay anonymous or be called by your full name or by a username/nickname please let us know in the comment section so we can adjust accordingly in the next update.

 Camera shake effects when casting abilities. This is a work in progress and probably needs adjustments. We think this is an excellent way to add more feedback to the game and hope you'll enjoy it!

 Loïc Bouchard has upgraded more Forest Rooms so you can walk more freely. He also added secret locations. Hope you'll enjoy! Note : some of the extended parts of the terrain are unwalkable for the AI. We are seeking a way to resolve this issue.

 The portals will show the name of the room instead of the Open text when close enough.


Fixes :


 The destroyable rocks and trees gave us trouble with performance. They where partially the cause of the "not responding" loading screen issues. Fixing this bug made us learn a lot about the hidden calculations that Unity does and it really brought benefits to the performances as you'll see by playing.

 @Rylatar gave us a very good list of English sentences to fix or rework. We've started applying her ideas, although the list was so long we did not have the time to cover everything for today so we'll do that in two separate updates.

 The default sound setting where too loud. We've changed the default sound settings based on a capture made by @Pamelot! Tell us if this pleases you or if we missed something.

 The Cyclop Boss used to stun you with his charge attack. We removed this malus since it was more confusing than anything.

 We fixed the treasure chests spawners.

 Fixed a sound glitch that occured when throwing a fire ball with the first upgrade.



We will spend the next week on more of the feedback we noted before focusing additions again. Stay tuned for what's coming next!

Happy Valentines Day!
 —The Team

notes.title: Destructible Environment & Extended Frontiers
notes.content:
Last week was focused on improving the gameplay of our combat rooms. We wanted to reduce the restrictions of our rooms and allow players to explore.

Additions :


 Players can reach the top of huge obstacles such as big rocks.

 We adjusted the collision of trees.

 Most of the trees should have mesh collisions instead of capsules. This will improve the precision of calculations.

 Whenever you dash through a tree, you destroy it. You may have to use the dash a few times.

 Players can shoot projectiles at small to medium rocks to break them.

 The field combat rooms have extended borders. Those two scenes have more than tripled in size. This was possible because of our new team member : Loïc Bouchard! He will use his talent to create the upcoming rooms of the next levels. By exploring the field rooms, you'll be pleased to uncover secret locations. This opens a lot of possibilities when we decide to make unique NPCs or hidden rewards! We are really excited to have him work with us and we hope you'll enjoy his work as much as we do!

 Loïc has also reworked our Challenge Room since the last one didn't go easy on our GPU. He also added his own touch to it!

 Furthermore, we removed the wolf wave from the Challenge Room. We recycled those units into common monsters by lowering their stats. Tell us if this nerf was enough!

 Whenever the enemies are on fire, you'll hear a subtle flame sound.

 Enemies get stronger the more you complete levels. Right now the stat bonus is about 20%, might increase since the players are usually a lot stronger with the rewards in their inventory.

 We just added a new enemy type to Stravux : Wyverns!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/9c1a47cd186340c2695343bf3b2e5bbb4918156f.gif

 Our Steam page has been updated. A trailer should follow soon!



We believe it is time to reveal our participation to the Games From Quebec Steam Sale! 

To celebrate, @NelsieOo from Instagram will livestream Chaos Crown during the first few hours of the event. She'll spealk French. I'll be in the comment section to discuss in both English and French, see you there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/472177ad0acbd72fbeb66555517b8b5069c52276.jpg

Tell us what you think of this update! We hope to completely remove invisible walls from the game as soon as players can swim. We also noted that there is feedback missing from the gameplay. We just found a tool that may fix this issue in the next updates!

Have a nice week!
-The Team.

notes.title: Thedgrut the Merchant
notes.content:
A brand new menu designed by @NelsieOoz on Instagram! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/841aed6cc528d2dc14a8254208e677e9a5eebedf.jpgWe are happy to start the year with the introduction of our second Treasure Room character : Thedgrut!


Additions :


 Thedgrut will appear in any treasure room. Get close to him to start looking at his products.

It currently features 3 items in the demo, more in the full game. You can reset the articles for a starting price of 50 gold. It'll increase by 150 for each previous reset.

 Some portals were too low, we adjusted them.

 When you consume items as ingredients in the crafting menu, you still keep the previous effects you had. To clarify this, you'll see the consumed items in your inventory. Their icons will be saturated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/d6ce0e2d1510059351f17682ae79880fec4dea65.png

 We are thinking about adding static items to the shop, maybe potions too. This is obviously a work in progress and your ideas will impact what will be added next to Thedgrut's inventory! Link to our Discord Server here.

 Furthermore, we started working on a Map Menu :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/1883ca4490be25c0989396768619348a2baba518.jpg

No assets have been made for it, its all placeholders and it will be updated soon. With this menu, we can finally switch between maps after the final boss is vanquished. This wont impact the Demo since the other maps are not included, but you'll be able to preview what the full game has to offer.

 The player should always respawn correctly if he passes through the ground with a new script that we added. Let us know if you find a case that is not covered.

 We improved the collision calculations. This might bring a lot of issues so keep an eye open for anomalies.

 If something costs too much, its red. If something is within your current budget its simply white.

 The procedural path handles multiple levels and the level that you choose first gets saved correctly. We still have to increase the stats of the enemies based on how many levels you completed. The second map you choose gives you a bonus of 20% xp.


That's it for now. You can expect to see a level up menu and a map menu rework very soon! 

We might get featured in a front page event in a few weeks, the remaining time we have will be spend on improving the gameplay even more to please those who will try our demo during this period of time. 

Is there something too annoying that we should really fix before this event? We are listening, tell us!

We wish a great year to everyone!

The team.

notes.title: Economy Upgrades
notes.content:
Additions :


 You start with no gold.

 All monsters give more gold.

 Gold bags give more gold.

 Reward Chests grant you a flat +100 gold bonus instead of a percentage bonus. This 100g bonus can be increased by up to 100% depending of your progression in the procedural path.

 Portals show a key notification in the middle of the screen instead of on the right of the screen.

Players might have too much gold in this version of the game. Howerver, we expect this situation to not last for long since the shop will soon be available.

Happy Holiday!
ㅡThe team.

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Since last week, we mainly worked on minor tweaks to soften the overall gameplay.


Additions :


 Crafted items have cooldowns. We generate cooldowns based on the effects to keep control of the system. Let us know if you wish to see adjustments to specific combinaisons.

 The crafted items are showing the cooldown between each effect when selected. The icon is a creation of @NelsieOo on Instagram!

 Touching a portal wont activate it, a key must be pressed to use it.

 A key notification shows the key to press when entering a portal.

 You no longer start with a skill point and an ability point. We decided it will be easier to introduce new players to the progression system a bit later when players get to level up for the first time.

 Treasure rooms appear as the only choice since there is no reason to pick anything else.

 Treasure rooms appear every 2 completed rooms. The demo should be way more entertaining this way.

 Challenge rooms wont show as your only choice. We beleive you should enter this type of room willingly.

 Mimic Curses have been added to the Crafting System (I did not find the time to test all of them so let me know if you have any issues).

 With a few teaks, we optimized the Challenge Room and the "Orange Treasure Room" since they were pretty heavy on odler computers.


Fixes :


 Crafted items with gold spawning effects are fixed.

 The "double sound" bug with the player voice is fixed.



A friendly reminder that our Discord Server is always open! 

We are going to start working on a shop very soon!

If you wish to follow the progress of the features in live, we have a public Trello open to anyone!

Happy Holiday!
ㅡThe team.

notes.content:

notes.title: Crafting System
notes.content:
Additions :

 Craft menu! Designed by @Nelsieoo on Instagram, it features this update's main addition : a modular Crafting System!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/a1259c1aa3dca157ddb3e8d79613f628451bb314.jpg

You'll need two items and the required amount of gold to merge rewards togheter. The order is important  since the first item decides when to proc the effect of the second. If you're familiar with maths, you'll quickly see that the amount of combinations will grow very fast with each available item. Just in the Chaos Crown demo, you can theorically try about 595 combinations.

Merging two rewards does not destroy them. You'll keep their bonus but wont be able to see or use them as ingredients as long as the crafted item remains in your inventory.

Notes : this system is still in progress. We need to support the mimic's curses AND add cooldowns to effects in order to prevent crazy use-case that can almost crash the game. That's right, you can become so powerfull that the game can't handle it. Have fun while it lasts!

 The blacksmith that crafts items for you will always chill in the treasure rooms.

 You'll get reminded by the UI to spend your ability points and your skill points.

 We tried to make the combat menu easier to see by increasing the size of abilities and adding a litle bit of space between them.

 Health bars should be easier to see.

 Repulsion balls's zone visual will fade depending of the distance. This should fix most of the visual issues we had with them.

 Added a hint to the loading screen to mention the crafting system.

 Dialogue zones will shut down when enemies are nearby.

 You can break a dash with the jump key to make your jump stronger. This was requested by @ccfireball and we absolutely loved the result! The game feels a litle more responsive with this addition.

 There is now only one shorcut for the inventory menu (Tab/Select by default).

 The movement speed now scales with the trigger of the controller. 


Ballance :


 Wood mask now shoots a projectile instead of a dash.

 Chalice of Greed's curse (Greedy) will give about 8% chance to lose 100 gold on hit.

 The mimic's explosion now starts with the cooldown on, so it has to wait a few seconds before going full kamikaze.

 Lowered the mimic's spawn rate from 30% to 8%. We beleive that for them to be enjoyable, they should be rare enough to supprise you.

 Increased the cooldown of the mimic's dash from 0.9 sec to 3 sec.


Bugs :


 We fixed an issue that made the mouse unusable with the Steam Controller. To  fix this, we had to remove the mouse from the detection of device changes. 

What this means for everyone is that you must now press a random key of the keyboard in order to switch from Xbox to PC. We might add an option for those who would want the switching system to detect the mouse again.

 Fixed an issue that caused combat musics to start before you could actually decide to fight monsters.


I want to point out a change in our team :

A change of lifestyle on my side will make Antoine's services unaffordable for an undertermined period of time. So our team is missing someone to craft the room's visuals while I'm focusing on the key features of Chaos Crown. We can expect the release date to get delayed since we think releasing Chaos Crown in Early Access would be a bad idea for a first game. You can be sure howerver that even if I have to craft the rooms myself I'll take the time to do things right before releasing our project to Steam.


We are exepecting the crafting system to be imperfect in its first days. You will probably find combinations that just dont work and some items might be too strong or too weak. This system is bigger than us, your help will be essential to improve it so please, join our Discord!

We might not have enough time to push another update before Chrismas. In case it happens we wish you all a good time with your friends and families!

Take care,
The team.

notes.title: Champion Levels
notes.content:
This update mostly changes the progression system and adds quality of life improvements. Still a work in progress. If you have anything to share about Chaos Crown, our Discord is always open :) Here are the changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/c9905a055c61c58f90e74cbdac227d526614eab9.jpg

Additions :


 Killing enemies grants xp.

 With enough xp, you level up. There is no cap to levels, howerver each level demands more xp. For the sake of the demo, you gain quite a lot of xp per monster.

 You gain a skill point on level up.

 Champions start the game with a free skill point and a free ability upgrade.

 You can spend skill points in the skills tree. You can also upgrade an ability for free for each level up.

 You can  open the character menu with the TAB key or the select button of the controller.

 Opening the skills tree pauses the game.

 You can open the skills tree with T or the upper arrow on the controller. Note : this binding has not been added (yet) to the options menu.

 The inventory menu now shows the skills tree button and lets you upgrade your character (its the same menu opened by the TAB key now).

 @Nelsieoo  added a new currency icon for the skills points :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/0d2422a0bd0c1a519723316c42d26abbd91e522e.png

 Combat texts show the xp gained.

 Combat text show the skill points gained.

 You get notified on level up with a white explosion and a text on top of the screen. You still have to remember to upgrade your skills which is no easy task if you level up in the midle of a difficult fight. If you have an idea of what could improve this process let us know in the comment section.

 Collecting collectibles such as critical orbs or fire gems will show a combat text too.

 You lose all upgrades, stacks, gold and items on death, victory or abandon.

 A brand new Combat Menu by @Nelsieoo on Instagram!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/ae01bdcca627ae56a7ab2b97ff12b24a9de6d05b.png

 Behind the scenes, Antoine Fortin has started to work on the ice rooms. We have nothing conclusive to show in this early stage, but it really feels good to test in a completly new environment!


Quality of life improvements :


 A new font has been added to the game.

 Small minions such as baby spiders have now 20 hp, you should oneshot them with any champion.

 Most of the monsters have reduced health. We want our game to feel fast-spaced, this is only the first step towards achieving this goal.

 Damage over time texts are now smaller than direct damage. This should help keep track of what damage you just did with a fire ball for example.

 Outside of combat, players get a 35% movement speed increase. We hope this will ease the exploration of big rooms without making small rooms unwalkable.


Fixes :


 Some ground calculations weren't functionning as expected. We fixed what we've found.

 The character voices volume weren't following the master volume.


The gold is useless now lol. Dont you worry, we'll find something for you to invest in soon ;)

We are currently exploring the idea of a crafting system that involves merging item rewards togheter. 

One item would define the context : "whenever you deal direct damage," and the other what happens : "you cast a fire explosion". Would this be more exciting than the shop we talked about?


Have a nice day!

The team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/e2fd1153d38c5542c82eb920fc67f85d12010007.png

notes.title: What's to Come
notes.content:
We took some time to think. Now here is what we planned :


Additions :


 Stack UI in the combat menu to see the collectibles you gained (for example with the archer's critical collectibles).

 Combat texts to give more feedback to the players.

 You will gain xp when killing monsters.

 You will level up.

 You will gain skill points on level up to upgrade your skills tree.

 You will also be able to upgrade an ability for free on level up.

 When you complete your skills tree, skills points can be used inside the character menu to increase a stat of your choice by a certain amount per skill points.

 You will lose all progress on death, including skills trees and stat upgrades.

 The map levels wont be linear. You will be allowed to choose which level to play next until the final level is the only one that remains. We will ballance enemies with a bonus stat each time you complete a level.

 All the xp you gain is also added to a mastery skill line that keeps progression outside of your games.

 Mastery skill points can upgrade the mastery skills tree which improves your gameplay experience by unlocking in game content for all champions.

 A runic skills tree will be available to all chamption. Each skill slot of the tree will display choices. This should allow you to make custom builds and try different strategies with each playable champions.

 There will be a shop where you can buy items.

 Reward items will serve as ingredients in the shop to create legendary items.

 Some reward items will have secret synergies. They will combine automatically once in your inventory.

 Some envrionment obstacles will be destructible to fix the "I'm getting stucked" issue.

 The combat system will support irregular terrains. The upcoming levels will have a more interesting terrains.

 We will add five additionnal levels before the release date.

 New enemy types with unique behaviours.

 A special AI type for the final boss rooms.

 More encounters for the procedural path.

 More Chaos Lords to encounter.

 More champions to play.

 If you take a potion while high on health, you will gain an active item to consume the potion instead of drinking it for nothing.

 Challenge rooms will reward you with an additional reward : the champion's brew, a legendary potion that restores all your health and increases your max health until the end of the game.



UI :


 A new font will be added to menus.

 A recap menu will show how you performed after your completed a level or on death.

 The character menu, the reward menu and the endgame menu will be reworked.

 A character lore sheet will introduce you to the story of your selected champion.

 We will add a help button on each menu to explain in detail each functionnality.

 The tutorial menu will have short videos.

 You will be able to spend skills points at all time with a shorcut that will open the skills tree menu (we are thinking about the tab key)



Options :


 We will support color blindness.

 Key rebinding will detect duplicates.

 Key rebinding will contain preconfigurations for the azerty and querty keyboards.

 You will be able to choose if you want a reticle or not.

 You will be able to choose if you want the game to perform calculations to help you shoot or not.

 You will be able to customize the text size of the tooltips.

 The Steam translation label will be synched with the game options.

 You will have the choice to see text damages or not.



Multiplatform :


 There will be ps4 controller support.

 There will be steam controller support.



Steamworks :


 We will support remote play.

 We will suggest a configuration for steam controllers.



If you read to this line, you should really consider joining our Discord Server!

This is what we currently want to see added to Chaos Crown. Now tell us what you think! We might be short on time before the launch, so if we know your favorite additions we will know what to prioritize first.

I want to thank every one for the feedback we already received.

Nelsie Oozeer and Antoine Fortin will help us acheive this goal. This would not be possible without them, thanks guys!

We slowed down a bit to process the feedback given by you guys while planning what's next for Chaos Crown. We will declare our intents to the Community this weekend.

If you want to give us feedback, our Discord is always open!

Additions :

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/24032726cba7f3186489a25df8f1616d3c88aa33.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/cd43dd1c9efe0105f13c09c506ecfac5e9cd2d4c.png

They will try to kamikaze and if their explosion touches you once, you will not only lose your chance to get one of three rewards, but you will also get a cursed item instead. There are currently four cursed items, more in the futur.

 Brand new Options Menu. This one will be able to hold a lot of options. Credits to @Nelsieoo on Instagram! More options coming soon.

 Key Rebinding. It was asked a lot, it was our top priority since the fest. It is stable, howerver we are currently  not checking if you bind duplicates. Use this menu with caution while we continue to work on this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/c38db3166391cc5b3935baf5f7688a267ecbfb02.jpg

 We are no longer deleting saves with each version change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/3e011c4acea09f8186bb3b456685a30c682ef10d.png

 The .exe is now updated with the game version.

 The .exe has now the Chaos Crown icon.

 We improved how AIs are choosing abilities. This is currently used with the mimic's dash.

 The auto selection for UI is now only active on console.

 Combat Musics are now dynamic and can trigger in any room when an enemy appears. This will be usefull for upcoming encounters and already is with the mimics.


Fixes :

 The divine coin was not triggering steam stats. We think we fixed this. Let us know if you find this issue again.

 The circle shaders should now render in the right order.

notes.title: You played the demo? Tell us what is missing!
notes.content:
Chaos Crown is about five to eight months from its release. We still have to add new enemies, new levels, new items and new champions. 

We are aware that there is still something missing to the game. Especially to keep players engaged after maxing out champions or simply after defeating all the boss and the challenge rooms. We are starting to look at successfull games similar to Chaos Crown so we dont miss any key feautres.

You know something we dont. You tried the demo. For some reason you decided to spend time playing Chaos Crown. Why? What is the key aspect of the game that brought you to press the download button? Did you find what you wanted after playing the demo? Is there something you secretly want us to add? What can we add for you? Now is the time to tell us. We are planning the next months. Afterwards we may have to wait a few months before being able to spend time on new ideas.

Here are the points that already have been made by players :

 Items could merge together automatically, revealing suprise synergies that would force players to adapt their way of playing on each run.
 Key rebinding is missing (currently working on it)
 We should diversify enemies, make less melee enemies.
 Players should know the lore behind their champion and what the quest for the Chaos Crown is all about.


If you want to discuss about it directly with the devs, our Discord is always open!

notes.content:
Encounters!

Our first encounter features Mazoku, the first Chaos Lord you'll encounter in the game :

He will offer you three artifacts to choose from. Select your choice and get an exclusive bonus reward! But beware! Chaos Lords like to... well make things a bit chaotic.

Main Menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/39a69c9cf24b2637027d69c14d1a327665d80edc.jpg

Our Main Menu is now ready. Since we are also planning to release an open beta soon, a wishlist button has been added. Thanks to @nelsieoo on Instagram, the menu is astonishing!

New Enemies!

We are slowly building challenge rooms. In order to not screw things up, we are adding one enemy type at a time. This update brings two of them :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/b7a34499f7d64edab1c76232d6c248d6bd7b5248.gif

Bears. Like real bears, running away is meaningless. We planned to add a bleed effect on hit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/bd5a07dbe2944470200a3175695d60720adb8691.gif

Wolves. They are using a brand new behaviour. You'll notice that they do not follow the same path and that some of them will try to circle you while others are simply charging at you. You might want to use area effects to deal with them and always check in your back for suprise attacks.

Portal Icon System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/ddf60a309bc86b40ada26616699e572e316febb3.gif

Portals will now have icons instead of flat texts. In time, you'll learn the meaning behind each room icon.

When you have an encounter with a Chaos Lord awaiting, this icon will show up : 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/72c573f39f0ba16a4159b2cf72f4a79d371c3bd4.gif

Other additions


 You can now open your inventory with the I key.
 Resting shrines can now be found only in challenge rooms.
 Losing the game will bring you to the character selection menu instead of the main menu.
 Portal icons wont show in menus that are using the character preview angle.
 Chaos Items will now only be available in the Chaos Lord encounters.
 The game now saves the amount of items per item. This will be usefull for stacked items such as Chaos Marks wich are malus obtained by accepting a deal with a Chaos Lord.
 The Cyclop boss is now mostly ballanced and has three abilities : single target tornado, area effect tornado and charge.


That's it for now! Our next move will be to enhance the gameplay and to provide the visual tools required to keep track of what's happening while in combat. Also, we will start to ballance the Lava Elemental and the Archer. Some skills might be completly reworked in order to receive good comments in the upcoming open beta.

Credits for UI elements goes to @nelsieoo on Instagram!

Enjoy the beach and the sun guys!
The team.

notes.title: Procedural Rooms and New Enemies
notes.content:
This update brings out our true vision of the game. Every Steam Branches are now up-to-date with our current version of the game. Here are the patch notes :

Additions : 

 Changed the name of the game from Arena Lab to Chaos Crown. You will learn more about our lore elements in the next weeks.
 A procedural room system. We have not yet made different scenes so for now its the same Forest Map as always, but the content varries depending on the room type. Once you clear the objective of the room, portals will open. A temporarly title tells you what type of room a portal represents.
 Monster Rooms : you must fight a team of enemies.
 Challenge Rooms : you must fight three waves of enemies and you get a hidden random item. Contains a resting shrine.
 Challenge Boss Room : you must fight two waves of bosses and you get a random item. Contains a resting shrine.
 Treasure Rooms : you get to choose between three random items.
 Resting shrines : you might see a bright spotlight. This is a resting shrine. You can get into the light to show the character menu an improve your character in-game and throw active items.
 Young wasp enemies.
 Big zombie enemies.
 Imp enemies.
 New spider enemies.
 Mushroom enemies.
 Treant boss.


Let us know if you find any bugs and what improvements you think we should do next!

notes.title: Update : 34 new rewards, skills tree visual and more!
notes.content:
A new type of items is now available : actives. We also included alternate gamplay items to make your choices harder to make. The most aggressive items wont be available in the normal reward pool forever, because we are planning to implement a devil deal mechanic. 

Here are the patch notes :

Additions :

 34 items are now available in the reward pool.
 A brand new skill tree menu.
 The picked up items are now saved. You should not encounter the same item in the same game.
 Some items now have the feature to boost all enemies.
 Reward Menu reworked, new visual too.
 A hit VFX System is implemented, but it has not been feed with VFX yet.
 An Inventory History System is implemented to remind of the player which item has been just taken while in combat.
 You can drop actives in the Reward Menu, in combat using the key G and in the Character Menu by drag and drop.
 Trowed items are represented by Item Crates. You can hit them to take the item back.
 A message system has been implemented to notify the player. This is currently used to tell the player he has reached his active cap when trying to take items back.
 A brand new visual to the Ability Bar.
 An icon to show the upgradable status of abilities in the character menu.
 Buffs and debuffs on tooltips are now showed in a more meaningful way.


Special thanks to @NelsieOo on Instagram for her hardworking on the project. We wouldn't have seen such visual improvements without her help. Send her love on Instagram!

We are currently working on an open Demo with a procedural room system. Exciting content is coming soon! You can get insight on what we are doing on Twitter  and Youtube.

notes.title: Upcoming Additions
notes.content:
We made huge progress on the upcoming mega patch. Let's take a look at what has been done :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/874f35cb27fb7a17deb5c4ca48e5a131f2ff788c.png
New Reward Menu
Here it is! Thanks to  @NelsieOo on Instagram, the Rewards Menu has been polished to this current state. Its functionalities remain the same.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/161dbce2c8ab6dd35b30e924e569347b35a1d300.png
New Ability Bar
A polished version of the Ability bar will soon be published!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/91fb4b20e4b088ccb4d07c558b5db436b8821a22.png
Active Items
A new type of item will be available from the rewards : actives. You can hold up to 3 actives at the same time. Use the mouse wheel to switch between them. 

If you try to take an active in the reward menu while having a full inventory, you will get to this menu : 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/9245b303b1b01e159f336f2e27f52ba214861577.png

In game, you will get this notification instead :
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/99d9617044ab16d94d2e2bbf9369ab9e41229abf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39988126/a66ea5097537ad91daeb860d6b03fee105817f91.png
In Game Rewards
While exploring, you may encounter mystery boxes. They can contain any item of the game! Just destroy those crates to get your bonus reward.

We tried to show the inventory of the player in a more meaningful way. The actives can be arranged by draging and droping them. You can also destroy them if you want by droping them outside the inventory background. Of course, a popup will ask you if you really want to destroy the active.

30 of the 100 rewards of the next patch are also ready to be published.

That's it for now. More to come in the next weeks!

notes.title: Update : Balance and Item System Changes
notes.content:
The next two months will be focused on bringing 100 new items available in the rewards menu. In order to do this, changes to the combat system and to the overall balance of the game are required. Here are the first changes : 

We nerfed the stacks passives and we updated the tooltip text calculation for each type of item.
Stacks are now loss on death.
Fixed an issue that caused the player to keep its stacks when winning a game.

notes.title: Update : Dash for the Lava Elemental and Incoming Characters Preview System
notes.content:
The last week was spend on the refactor of the Lich's abilities and some tweaks that make the game even more enjoyable. Here are the patch notes :

Additions :

 A completly new skill bar for the lich.
 A dash for the Lava Elemental. This ability will remplace the fire breath, but will keep its synergies. An upgrade now removes the ability bar cost of the dash, making it really strong when fully upgraded.
 A preview system that lets you see unfinished characters. We beleive that this will make it easier to promote future content.
 A new ability upgrade system. You may now click on the abilities in the upgrade menu to upgrade them.


Bug fixes :

 Fixed a timing issue when placing area effects. You should never encounter this issue again.

notes.title: Update : Archer Skills Tree, Fixes and More!
notes.content:
The last two weeks were spend on the Archer. We started with an overall improvements of the skills and then added synergies. Some of those additions brought new interactions with the environment. You will find this new gameplay refreshing and a lot more reactive than the conservative version of the Lava Elemental. Here are the patch notes :

Additions:

 Archer Skills Tree.
 Movement Speed Stat. This stat will only change the movement speed while the speed will still touch the overall speed modifiers.
 Attack Speed Stat. This stat will also only change the attack speed while the speed will still touch the overall speed modifiers.
 Deathtouch stat. This stat gives you chances to kill instantly a non-boss target.
 Critical Changes stat. This stat gives you chances to deal double damage on hit.
 Repulsion orbs. When the round starts, blue balls may spawn. You can hit them with your basic attack to knockback yourself and the enemies inside of its radius.
 Treasure chests may spawn when starting a round.


Quality of Life Improvements :

 The game now remembers the last character chosen.
 The ability preview system now sets its color based on the current character.
 Ranged enemies should now flee for a shorter duration and should not go too far from the Player.


Bug fixes :

 The projectiles should now have a better calculation of their rotation when spawned.
 Projectiles should no longer collide between them or with their owner.

notes.title: Update : 6 New Enemies, Ability Zone Preview, Character Menu Reworked and More!
notes.content:
Last week, we decided that it was time to pause the production of passives and abilities to make the experience of testing more rich and enjoyable. Here are the patch notes, enjoy! 

Additions : 

 A tier two level of difficulty round based on the slime thematic. You will encounter 6 types of enemies : melee slime, ranged slime, ranged boss slime, slime man, slime man minion, slime man boss. The final wave is something to see and should be a rough challenge for non-maxed champions.
 An ability preview system for ranged area effects. Holding a button will show the preview and releasing it will place the ability.


Quality of life improvements :

 Back option in the Character Menu. This should have been available from the start. We appologize for the time it took to have it.
 The skills tree and the ability bar are visible while choosing the character to play. This should make choices easier and improve quality of life.
 Life potions. This addition has been requested from many players and has been implemented! There are low chances to drop them, but you should see them sometimes. Let us know if the drop rate is too low to make a difference.
 New UI assets from @NelsieOo on Instagram have been integrated in the Character Menu.
 The pause menu is actually pausing the game :)


Balance :

 The Corrosive Lava passives of the Lava Elemental have been halved in value.
 The Fire Rain ability's scaling ratio has been halved.
 The Resistance calculation has been changed as follows : Damage below Resistance are reduced by 70% while the rest passes as true damage.
 Each character of the game has been buffed of 15 points of damage and 10 points of resistance.


Bug fixes :

 The Fire Ball ability was doing no damage, this has been fixed.
 The Cauterize ability was doing no damge, this has been fixed.
 The goats are now using the most updated combat behaviour. They should be more reactive and more aggressive.


Translation fixes :

 The fireball passive #6's description has been corrected.

notes.title: Update : Lava Elemental Complete Skills Tree
notes.content:
During the previous two weeks, we worked on the Lava Elemental's skills tree. While doing so, we also encountered bugs which are now successfully fixed. Major changes have been made to the combat system. Those changes unfortunately broke many of the other character's abilities. To prevent users from having crashes, we temporary disabled the Archer. the Ent and the Lich. You can still play them in the stable branch of the build. You should now have a good idea of the Lava Elemental's gameplay as you discover the main features of its skills tree. I hope you enjoy it, here are the patch notes :

New Additions :

 Added the complete skills tree for the Lava Elemental, this includes around 24 passives and 25 ability upgrades.
 Added an ability resource bar for the Lava Elemental which fills itself with a portion of the damage that you deal. Some abilities may now consume charges to be cast.
 Added a gold text in the combat menu.
 Added collectable gold coins.
 Added a black icon on the top of the abilities when they cannot be cast.
 Added the ability bar in the upgrade menu.
 Added a post processing layer to enhance the visual effects and the overall colours of the game.


Bug fixes :

 Fixed many save system errors. The users should now save and load a game properly.
 Fixed reference errors liked to effects over time such as the fire or the poison status.


Please let us know if you find any bugs. Have a nice day!
